BMW 5 Series

2019–2022 · 2.0 petrol · automatic · Business class

  • 5 seats, 3 suitcases
  • Chauffeur service available

Clients who want the 5 Series usually ask for it by name. In our business category it is the driver's car: sharper steering than its rivals, rear-wheel drive, and a chassis that makes the curves between Gudauri and Kazbegi genuinely enjoyable rather than merely survivable.

The 2.0 petrol engine returns roughly 7.5 l/100 km — a little thirstier than the diesel alternatives, which is the price of the way it drives. Five seats and three suitcases make it practical enough for a family, though most bookings are corporate: conferences, investor visits, weddings. Chauffeur service is available if you would rather work from the back seat.

Two practical notes. Clearance is 135 mm, so speed bumps in Vake and courtyard entrances need care, and gravel is out of the question — the unpaved roads to Ushguli and Omalo are reserved for the off-road 4x4 category. The rate is 310 ₾ a day with a 1,000 ₾ deposit, and drivers must be 25 or older. Weekly and monthly rates are listed on Prices.

Booking and enquiries

This site is informational — there is no online payment. Call or email us to book.
